<?php
/**
 * Multi-tenant notification dispatcher CLI tool
 * Usage: php notify.php --tenant=<id> --template=<name> --recipient=<email>
 * 
 * Tenant isolation is enforced via configuration-based sender mapping.
 * Each tenant has pre-approved sender addresses and display names.
 */

class TenantConfig {
    private array $tenants;
    
    public function __construct(string $configPath) {
        $realPath = realpath($configPath);
        if ($realPath === false || !str_starts_with($realPath, '/etc/notify/')) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid config path');
        }
        $raw = file_get_contents($realPath);
        $this->tenants = json_decode($raw, true) ?? [];
    }
    
    public function getSenderAddress(string $tenantId): ?string {
        return $this->tenants[$tenantId]['sender_address'] ?? null;
    }
    
    public function getSenderName(string $tenantId): ?string {
        return $this->tenants[$tenantId]['sender_name'] ?? null;
    }
    
    public function getReplyTo(string $tenantId): ?string {
        return $this->tenants[$tenantId]['reply_to'] ?? null;
    }
    
    public function isValidTenant(string $tenantId): bool {
        return isset($this->tenants[$tenantId]);
    }
}

class EmailSanitizer {
    /**
     * Validates an email address format
     */
    public static function validateEmail(string $email): bool {
        return filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) !== false;
    }
    
    /**
     * Sanitizes a header value by removing dangerous characters.
     * Prevents CRLF injection in header values.
     */
    public static function sanitizeHeaderValue(string $value): string {
        // Remove carriage returns and newlines to prevent header injection
        return str_replace(["\r", "\n"], '', $value);
    }
    
    /**
     * Encodes a display name for use in email headers using RFC 2047.
     * This handles special characters and prevents injection via display names.
     */
    public static function encodeDisplayName(string $name): string {
        // First sanitize CRLF
        $clean = self::sanitizeHeaderValue($name);
        // RFC 2047 encode if non-ASCII present
        if (preg_match('/[^\x20-\x7E]/', $clean)) {
            return '=?UTF-8?B?' . base64_encode($clean) . '?=';
        }
        // Quote the display name if it contains special chars
        if (preg_match('/[()<>@,;:\\".\[\]]/', $clean)) {
            return '"' . addcslashes($clean, '"\\') . '"';
        }
        return $clean;
    }
}

class HeaderBuilder {
    private array $headers = [];
    
    public function setFrom(string $name, string $address): self {
        $encodedName = EmailSanitizer::encodeDisplayName($name);
        $this->headers['From'] = $encodedName . ' <' . $address . '>';
        return $this;
    }
    
    public function setReplyTo(string $address): self {
        $this->headers['Reply-To'] = $address;
        return $this;
    }
    
    public function setContentType(string $type, string $charset = 'UTF-8'): self {
        $this->headers['Content-Type'] = $type . '; charset=' . $charset;
        return $this;
    }
    
    public function setCustomHeader(string $name, string $value): self {
        // Only allow X- prefixed custom headers
        if (strpos($name, 'X-') !== 0) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Custom headers must use X- prefix');
        }
        $safeName = EmailSanitizer::sanitizeHeaderValue($name);
        $safeValue = EmailSanitizer::sanitizeHeaderValue($value);
        $this->headers[$safeName] = $safeValue;
        return $this;
    }
    
    public function build(): string {
        $result = '';
        foreach ($this->headers as $name => $value) {
            $result .= $name . ': ' . $value . "\r\n";
        }
        return rtrim($result, "\r\n");
    }
}

class TemplateEngine {
    private string $templateDir;
    
    public function __construct(string $templateDir) {
        $this->templateDir = realpath($templateDir);
        if ($this->templateDir === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Template directory not found');
        }
    }
    
    public function render(string $templateName, array $vars): array {
        $safeName = basename($templateName);
        $path = $this->templateDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $safeName . '.json';
        
        if (!file_exists($path)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Template not found: ' . $safeName);
        }
        
        $template = json_decode(file_get_contents($path), true);
        $subject = $template['subject'] ?? 'Notification';
        $body = $template['body'] ?? '';
        
        // Sanitize all variable values before template substitution
        foreach ($vars as $key => $val) {
            $safeVal = EmailSanitizer::sanitizeHeaderValue($val);
            $subject = str_replace('{{' . $key . '}}', $safeVal, $subject);
            $body = str_replace('{{' . $key . '}}', htmlspecialchars($val, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'), $body);
        }
        
        return ['subject' => $subject, 'body' => $body];
    }
}

class NotificationDispatcher {
    private TenantConfig $config;
    private TemplateEngine $templates;
    
    public function __construct(TenantConfig $config, TemplateEngine $templates) {
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->templates = $templates;
    }
    
    public function dispatch(string $tenantId, string $templateName, string $recipient, array $extraVars = []): bool {
        if (!$this->config->isValidTenant($tenantId)) {
            fwrite(STDERR, "Invalid tenant: " . preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $tenantId) . "\n");
            return false;
        }
        
        if (!EmailSanitizer::validateEmail($recipient)) {
            fwrite(STDERR, "Invalid recipient email\n");
            return false;
        }
        
        $senderAddress = $this->config->getSenderAddress($tenantId);
        $senderName = $this->config->getSenderName($tenantId);
        $replyTo = $this->config->getReplyTo($tenantId);
        
        // Validate sender address from config is actually a valid email
        if (!EmailSanitizer::validateEmail($senderAddress)) {
            fwrite(STDERR, "Invalid sender configuration for tenant\n");
            return false;
        }
        
        $rendered = $this->templates->render($templateName, array_merge(
            ['tenant_id' => $tenantId, 'recipient' => $recipient],
            $extraVars
        ));
        
        $builder = new HeaderBuilder();
        $builder->setFrom($senderName, $senderAddress)
                ->setContentType('text/html')
                ->setCustomHeader('X-Tenant-ID', $tenantId);
        
        if ($replyTo && EmailSanitizer::validateEmail($replyTo)) {
            $builder->setReplyTo($replyTo);
        }
        
        $headers = $builder->build();
        $subject = EmailSanitizer::sanitizeHeaderValue($rendered['subject']);
        
        // Use PHP's mail() function with constructed headers
        // Additional parameter uses escapeshellarg for safety
        $result = mail($recipient, $subject, $rendered['body'], $headers);
        
        if ($result) {
            $this->auditLog($tenantId, $recipient, $subject);
        }
        
        return $result;
    }
    
    private function auditLog(string $tenantId, string $recipient, string $subject): void {
        $entry = sprintf(
            "[%s] tenant=%s to=%s subject=%s\n",
            date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $tenantId),
            $recipient,
            substr($subject, 0, 100)
        );
        file_put_contents('/var/log/notify_audit.log', $entry, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }
}

// CLI entry point
function main(): int {
    $opts = getopt('', ['tenant:', 'template:', 'recipient:',  'var:']);
    
    $tenantId = $opts['tenant'] ?? null;
    $templateName = $opts['template'] ?? null;
    $recipient = $opts['recipient'] ?? null;
    
    if (!$tenantId || !$templateName || !$recipient) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "Usage: php notify.php --tenant=<id> --template=<name> --recipient=<email>\n");
        return 1;
    }
    
    // Validate tenant ID format
    if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$/', $tenantId)) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "Invalid tenant ID format\n");
        return 1;
    }
    
    $extraVars = [];
    if (isset($opts['var'])) {
        $vars = is_array($opts['var']) ? $opts['var'] : [$opts['var']];
        foreach ($vars as $v) {
            $parts = explode('=', $v, 2);
            if (count($parts) === 2) {
                $extraVars[$parts[0]] = $parts[1];
            }
        }
    }
    
    $config = new TenantConfig('/etc/notify/tenants.json');
    $templates = new TemplateEngine(__DIR__ . '/templates');
    $dispatcher = new NotificationDispatcher($config, $templates);
    
    return $dispatcher->dispatch($tenantId, $templateName, $recipient, $extraVars) ? 0 : 1;
}

exit(main());
